name: Berkah Alam Outdoor Organizer
description: Ruled ledger sheet for a camping-gear rental shop. One oxide-red margin rule, 1px rules that terminate every field, monospaced figures for anything countable. Light only.

oxide-red.roleHint: margin rule, primary action, out-of-stock marker
oxide-red.note: Replaced a previous terracotta at oklch(0.646 0.222 41.116) that measured 3.46:1 against its own white label and failed WCAG AA.

oxide-red-ink.roleHint: label and icon on an oxide-red fill

paper.roleHint: page ground; the ruled sheet lives on this and is never a card on another fill

card-white.roleHint: interactive surfaces that lift off the paper by tone alone

ledger-rule.note: Not in the Stitch color schema; carried here because rules are the primary structural device of this system.

tint-apricot.roleHint: row hover tint, empty hero plate field

hairline.roleHint: component borders on inputs, cards, badges, media plates

alarm.roleHint: destructive actions and error states only

label.note: Uppercase mono column headers and field names. Never above a heading.

figure.note: Prices and stock counts. Requires font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

elevation.note: Depth comes from tonal layering and 1px rules only. There is deliberately no shadow vocabulary in this system.

tokens.overlay-border: 1px solid var(--color-rule); overlay tidak memakai shadow sama sekali

rule-draw.note: The single authored moment. Rules extend from the left margin as each field enters the viewport. Content is never hidden by it: only the rule animates.

rule-draw-y.note: The oxide-red margin rule writing itself down the sheet.

motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses every rule to its resting visible state with no transition or animation. Verified by rendering the page with motion forced off.

theming.note: Dark mode was removed by product decision. src/index.css carries no .dark token block and no @custom-variant dark; the codebase has zero dark: utilities. Do not reintroduce them: Tailwind v4's built-in dark variant is media-based, so any surviving dark: class would silently activate on an OS in dark mode.

rules: One Red Rule: oxide red appears at most once per viewport. Never two.
The Rules Are The Structure Rule: a visible boundary is a 1px rule, never a shadow.
The Ledger Voice Rule: monospace is for data and measurement only.
The No Eyebrow Rule: no small uppercase label above a heading.
The Flat-By-Default Rule: no box-shadow on any resting surface.
The Single Outline Rule: a bordered element never also carries a shadow.
Real rule elements only: no repeating-linear-gradient stripe grid as background texture.

button-primary.html: Lihat Katalog

button-secondary.html: Lihat lokasi

ledger-row.html: Tenda Dome 4PRp 80.00004 tersedia

input.html: <input class="h-8 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent px-2.5 text-base placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring" placeholder="Cari alat" />

northStar: The rental ledger. The shop's bookkeeping sheet is the mechanism that turns 'clean, checked, ready' from a promise into a row you can read, so the page is that sheet rather than a photograph of a campsite.
openDecisions: src/pages/CatalogPage.tsx memakai grid kartu untuk browsing (bukan baris tabel seperti di landing page). Card grid dipertahankan karena foto alat adalah bukti yang dinilai pengguna di halaman itu, sedangkan baris ledger dipakai untuk halaman yang hanya memindai data.
BookingDetailPage masih menampilkan 'a.n. Camping Rental' pada instruksi transfer bank. Itu fakta pemilik rekening milik backend dan sengaja tidak diubah.
PRD.md bagian 2.1 dan 8 masih menyebut dark mode sebagai syarat. PRD belum ditulis ulang.
Ukuran foto masih ukuran asli dari unggah admin; satu berkas dapat weigh 600 KB though tampil pada kartu ~380px maupun kotak 56px. Thumbnail belum dibuat.

sharedVocabulary.note: Satu-satunya tempat kosakata ledger tinggal. Primitive UI sudah diselaraskan global, bukan ditimpa per halaman.
